revisions.body:
# Play's content catalogue

Play does not read the rulebook Markdown. It imports the compiled JSON that `packages/content` writes to `dist/catalogues/play/{talents,races,conditions}.json`, exported as `@heartrush/content/play/<name>` and loaded in `apps/play/src/catalogue/index.ts`. The shapes are `PlayTalent`, `PlayRace`, `PlayChoice` and `RaceEffect` in `packages/content/src/types.ts`, mirrored by `packages/rules-engine/src/catalogue.ts`.

## Build before play

- Run `pnpm --filter @heartrush/content build` before play's typecheck or tests. `dist/` is not committed, so a fresh checkout or a source edit leaves play reading a missing or stale catalogue. Play's `build` and `test` scripts run it first; a bare `tsc --noEmit` in `apps/play` does not.
- Two builds at once (a workspace `pnpm build` beside another agent's, or the pre-commit hook beside a test run) write `packages/content/dist` at the same time and fail or leave it half-written. When that happens, build content once, then run play's `tsc --noEmit` and `vite build` separately rather than the combined script.

## Race effects are hand-written

What a race changes mechanically — XP cost changes, die caps, aspect rank caps, award bonuses, attunements, creation-time choices — is written by hand in `packages/content/src/race-effects.ts`, keyed by race file stem and subrace heading id. The compiler does not parse it from the race text.

- Express each effect as one of the typed `RaceEffect` kinds (`cost`, `dieCap`, `aspectRankCap`, `awardBonus`, `attunement`, `manual`). Never store a pre-computed total or a delta against another race; the rules engine computes totals from these kinds.
- Something the kinds cannot express is a `manual` effect carrying the rule text, not a new ad-hoc field.
- A choice the race text requires at creation is a `choice`, and only the selected option's abilities and effects apply ([[3zl47w7d-mvg8jc6i-331ad30f/kin-choices-contract]]).
- When you edit a race file in `heart_rush/races/`, check whether its entry in `race-effects.ts` still matches the text.

summary: Play reads packages/content dist/catalogues/play/*.json; build @heartrush/content first; race effects are typed kinds in race-effects.ts.
why_it_exists: Agents ran play's typecheck or tests against a stale or missing content build, and parallel builds collided over packages/content/dist.
